attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Regulation 7(2)(B) Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Prohibition Of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 Received From Mr. Himanshu Chhabra'.
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited disclosed that Himanshu Chhabra, Director and Chief Financial Officer, acquired 8,782 equity shares of the company on 23rd November 2026. The shares were purchased via the market. Each share has a face value of INR 10. This acquisition represents 0.006% of the total issued and paid-up equity share capital of Skyways Air Services Limited. The disclosure was submitted pursuant to Regulation 7(2)(a) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations 2015. The company forwarded this intimation to the stock exchanges on 23rd November 2026.

attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 17, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR1,311.45 crores for Q2, a 90.3% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 96% to INR58.47 crores, and PAT grew 129.6% to INR33.18 crores. For H1 FY27, revenue reached INR2,527.9 crores, with PAT at INR59.97 crores, a 135% increase. Air cargo volumes grew 27%. The company targets full-year revenue exceeding INR5,000 crores. Strategic updates include a renewed agreement with Qatar Airways, a new warehouse in Birmingham, UK, and an investment in Sageroute Logistics. The ASAP technology platform is in final testing for a Q4 launch.
